description: This PHP file defines the MembershipService class within the OrangeHRM project. It provides methods for managing membership entities, including creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and listing memberships, as well as checking for existing membership names. The service interacts with a corresponding DAO for database operations and uses traits for normalization functionality.

classes.name: MembershipService
classes.description: Provides business logic for managing membership entities, including CRUD operations, listing, and validation within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getMembershipDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the MembershipDao instance used for database operations.

methods.name: setMembershipDao
methods.description: Sets the MembershipDao instance, allowing dependency injection.

methods.name: saveMembership
methods.description: Saves the provided Membership entity to the database via DAO.

methods.name: getMembershipById
methods.description: Retrieves a Membership entity by its unique ID.

methods.name: getMembershipByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Membership entity by its name.

methods.name: getMembershipList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of memberships based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getMembershipCount
methods.description: Counts the number of memberships matching the search filter parameters.

methods.name: isExistingMembershipName
methods.description: Checks if a membership name already exists.

methods.name: getMembershipArray
methods.description: Returns all memberships normalized into an array format suitable for UI or other consumption.
